notes.title: Update 2.5.1.1
notes.content:
[fix] Points adding in each round

Every time I went into survival mode he added up the points he already had and so we had unreal points, now when playing survival mode the game loads the points you got from the story mode and joins them with the survival points when you lose.

notes.title: Update 2.5.1
notes.content:
[Fix] On the map screen, when pressing the save button, the game opened the stage that was behind the button.

[change] The hi-score now considers the percentage you played by adding up to the points you made in survival mode.

Note: To send your points you must play a survival mode game or pass all stages of the game.

notes.title: Update 2.5 - Hi-Scores
notes.content:
Update 2.5 brings online hi-scores in the menu, so we know who is the best in survival mode!

notes.title: Internal Update
notes.content:
After a while of trying and fixing bugs we were able to offer a working steam overlay!

Now you can take a screenshot with the F12 key and check your achievements and other things that steam overlay offers with the SHIFT+TAB!

Until later!

notes.title: Update 2.4
notes.content:
[fix] Fixed an achievement of 9000 points in survival that was not completed even after passing the points.

Thank you for reporting the error.

notes.title: Update 2.2.1
notes.content:
Hello Mercenary ...

We've made some corrections and improvements to the last minimap code, now the game will be 70% lighter due to an event loop that was consuming too much memory.

Now we have also changed the way the mobile platforms fall.
Thanks for the tips to our developer friend Fred.

See you...  :Likezombie:

notes.title: Update V2.0
notes.content:
Hello Mercenary, now you have to save and load your game manually, we have improved the way to deal with the minimap, now you will be able to see the whole phase in it and several icons for levers, buttons, ammo boxes, and medical kit.


Keymapping:

Soon we will improve the keypad mapping for gamepad just as we did for keyboard, let's make it more attractive and easy to use.


V2.0

[~] Weapon change is now done by "1", "2" and "mouse wheel".
[~] Mouse shooting now shows the correct shooting animation, (indentation).
[~] Modified damage system.
[~] The "Up" and "W" keys now do not jump but aim upwards.
[~] The "Spacebar" is now your jump button.
[~] The "E" key now activates and picks things up.
[~] The "F" key now launches C4.
[~] Modified the system Load and save the game.
[~] Save and load button icons are now 32x32px and have been redrawn.
[~] Minimap has been modified for ease of navigation.





[+] Flash effect is now shown when taking damage.
[+] Checkpoints are now available.
[+] Action buttons for those who die, you can choose between saved point or menu.
[+] Added confirmation window for saving and loading games.
[+] Minimap icons now for all cards, levers, and buttons.




Shhhhhh ...

Now a new cheat but don't tell anyone ...

At any stage press ", in the box type" iamrich "without the quotes, hit enter and you will have all the relics.

Until the next mercenary ...

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
V1.1.0

[~] Title has been modified.
[~] Minimap has been modified.
[~] Charging screen had code changed to improve loading and appear faster.
[~] Epilepsy warning screen goes out in 10 seconds or when you press a key.
[~] Changed power bar of bosses, the colors are according to the amount of HP.
[~] Changed the behavior of glass shards.
[~] We improved performance, so the recommended requirements were updated.




[+] Added final boss, Dr Taylor is now the final boss of the game.
[+] Added cheats.
[+] Added "Demon Bat". A kind of puppy of the evil thing that flies. 




[-] We remove the hardware information from the loading screen.

[!] To use cheats, at some stage press ", in the box that appears on the screen enter for example "drtaylorbattle" without quotes, after that die somehow, upon arriving at the level selection screen, all until Dr Taylor should be released.

[!] Dr Taylor's stage will only appear after you exit and enter the level selection screen. This is due to an engine mechanic to prevent your save game being deleted.


:Likezombie:
